note: FINDING: destination_runs.status is VARCHAR(20) on PostgreSQL but the engine writes 'completed_with_errors' (21 chars) when any delivery failed. Run against a real migrated PG database (webhook destination, two members, deliveries: lead 1 succeeds, lead 2 fails), handle_destination_sync raises at the final commit; the run stays 'running', the destination health is not updated, and only reconcile_destination_job_failure (after the queue's retries) moves the run to 'failed'. The router retry rule also accepts 'completed_with_errors', which can never exist on PG. Go uses the same column (no DDL): a decision is needed (see the report).
